The '''Cathar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]].
